name: User Added to Privileged Group (Linux)
description: An account was added to sudo, wheel, root, admin, or docker. Grants privilege escalation and is a frequent step after a foothold.
query: event.dataset:"system.auth" and process.name:("usermod" or "gpasswd") and message:("sudo" or "wheel" or "root" or "admin" or "docker" or "adm")
note:
### Triage
- Which account, which group, and who made the change?
- Pair with `soc-linux-new-local-user` — new account + immediate privileged-group add is high confidence.
